Part.name: Kontakt-1 ERA cassette
Part.description: Placeable reactive armour. One fixed cassette reacts once against eligible HEAT hits; other ammunition receives passive protection only. Up to 38% less remaining HEAT penetration; no reactive APFSDS benefit. About 7.4 kg. Return to Edit to restore spent cassettes. Gameplay calibration, not exact historical performance. Spent passive collision and mass remain; no tandem simulation.
